page.overview:
What is Tor Zireael?

Tower of the Swallow (Elder Speech: Tor Zireael), is a tower on the north shore of the lake Tarn Mira, in the Mil Trachta region. It was once the mythical seat of the elven mages and Aen Saevherne, and was paired with Tor Lara on Thanedd Island, however the Lara Portal became unstable and people eventually forgot where Tor Zireael was located. To add to the confusion, the tower's magical nature made it "lost" to the ages as many just see ruins where it sits and rarely does it reveal itself through the fog before disappearing just as quickly. As such, even notable scholars believe the tower is now just a myth.

In reality, it still exists but only shows itself to certain people and contains many magic portals through which one can travel to many different worlds. It's further believed that only chosen ones could command the tower to open a portal within, giving it the moniker "Gate of Worlds" and "Threshold of Time".

In late , Ciri, believing she could use the portal within to take her back to Thanedd and far away from those hunting her, made haste for this tower, eventually entering, but instead of going back to the island she entered the elven world of the Aen Elle.
